mechanics.name: Residual Manifest
mechanics.currentEffect: After a successful Killer Blind, the Killer suffers Blindness for 20/25/30 seconds. Once per Trial, Residual Manifest lets you rummage through an opened Chest and guarantees a Basic Flashlight.
activation: Successfully blind the Killer to apply Blindness.
Interact with an opened Chest to use the one rummage allowed by the perk.
Ends/deactivates when: Killer Blindness ends after 20/25/30 seconds.
Ends/deactivates when: The Chest rummage allowance is spent when used.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Blinding the Killer applies Blindness, and once per Trial you can rummage an opened Chest for a Basic Flashlight.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: One rummage allowance per Trial; it is consumed when rummaging an opened Chest.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: Can rummage an opened Chest once per Trial; that rummage guarantees a Basic Flashlight.
specialInteractions: The Killer Blindness effect can be triggered by blinds from Firecrackers, Flash Grenades, and Blast Mine.
When used with Appraisal, Residual Manifest's rummage token is consumed first.

editorial.summary: Blinding the Killer inflicts Blindness for up to 30 seconds, and once per Trial you can rummage an opened Chest for a guaranteed basic Flashlight.
useCases: Turn any successful blind into a longer period where the Killer loses Aura-reading support.
Guarantee access to a basic Flashlight without bringing one into the Trial.
Use the rummage after your original Item is consumed or when a chest is already open.
counters: Requires successful Killer blinds to apply the main effect.
Lightborn or careful anti-blind play can shut down most value.
The guaranteed Flashlight is basic rather than premium.
pros: Provides its own tool for activating the perk.
Thirty seconds of Killer Blindness can disable important Aura information.
cons: Very little value if blinds are denied.
One guaranteed basic Flashlight does not justify the slot alone.
analysis: Residual Manifest ranks this position because it is one of the more self-contained blind-build perks. Even if you enter without a Flashlight, one rummage can guarantee a basic one, giving the perk a path to its own activation.

The Blindness effect can be meaningful against Killers relying on Aura information. Thirty seconds is long enough to cover post-hook rotations, generator pressure, or several chase decisions where the Killer expected to see an Aura.
The obvious issue is that successful blinds are not free. A Killer can face walls during pickups, avoid pallet blinds, or bring Lightborn. In those matches the main effect struggles to appear.
Residual Manifest is therefore solid specialist utility. It is better than a pure meme perk, but too dependent on blind access for a general-purpose ranking.
editorial.verdict: A respectable blind-build support perk that even supplies its own basic Flashlight. Strong when blinds land, nearly invisible when they do not.
